meta.name: The Eternaut
meta.description: After a devastating toxic snowfall kills millions, Juan Salvo and a group of survivors in Buenos Aires must resist an invisible threat from another world.

videos.title: A Night of Cards
videos.overview: An eerie snowfall disrupts Juan's card night with friends. As tensions rise, they craft a suit for him to brave the storm and find his daughter.

videos.title: Step into the Sun
videos.overview: Salvo braves a ravaged Buenos Aires to reach Elena and Clara's apartment, discovering that human survival instincts can be as deadly as the toxic snow.

videos.title: Magnetism
videos.overview: Searching Clara's school for clues, Juan and Elena meet Pablo, a student in distress. Meanwhile, Tano attempts radio contact as Juan's visions intensify.

videos.title: The Creed
videos.overview: Tano and Juan head downtown, where they encounter a barricade and army forces. Confronted by a sudden threat, they receive help from an unexpected lot.

videos.title: Horizon
videos.overview: The group heads for the island, with Tano making a tough choice to ensure passage. On the way, they discover a refugee camp inside a deserted mall.

videos.title: Cold Tomato Juice
videos.overview: After a risky train mission back to the city, a mysterious bright light lures Juan away, leading him to an unimaginable discovery.
